truths: FolderPicker renders with empty state, picker button, manual input, and folder list
Native folder picker (Tauri dialog) opens and returns selected folder paths on the user's machine
Manual path entry adds folders to the list with immediate visual feedback
Remove button removes a folder from the list instantly
Empty path strings are rejected (form-level validation before adding)
ScanOptions renders with both checkboxes and numeric input in the correct layout
All state is local and accessible (no prop drilling needed yet — DuplicateFinder wires them in Wave 3)
artifacts: src/components/FolderPicker.tsx — folder picker component with Tauri dialog integration
src/components/ScanOptions.tsx — scan options component with toggles and numeric input
key_links: FolderPicker imports Button, Input from @/components/ui and FolderIcon from lucide-react
ScanOptions imports Checkbox, Label, Input from @/components/ui
Both components export their component type as default — used by DuplicateFinder in Wave 3
Tauri pickFolders() requires the dialog plugin registered in Wave 1 (lib.rs .plugin call)
ScanOptions options data flows through onChange callback to DuplicateFinder (Wave 3) which passes it to scan_folders Tauri command via invoke (data flow across all 3 waves)

truths: DuplicateFinder orchestrates FolderPicker and ScanOptions with proper prop passing
Clicking "Scan for Duplicates" collects folder paths + options and invokes the Tauri command
UI transitions from input view to progress view after scan starts
Progress view listens for Tauri scan:progress events
Progress view has a "New Scan" button that resets state and returns to input view
Form resets properly when a new scan is started (all state cleared)
artifacts: src/components/DuplicateFinder.tsx — full orchestrator with view state management
src/components/ScanProgress.tsx — progress bar with stats and reset button
key_links: DuplicateFinder imports FolderPicker and ScanOptions from @/components/FolderPicker and @/components/ScanOptions
ScanProgress imports Progress from @/components/ui/progress (installed in Plan 01)
Tauri command "scan_folders" is defined in src-tauri/src/lib.rs (Plan 01)
